messages:
sara-hr: Hey team  quick sync on Rafa's start. Two items: I-9 verification method (Rafa is overseas but work-authorized) and background check name mismatch. Need to confirm process before day 1.
lee-ops: If they're overseas and authorized, consular verification is an option (we accept embassy/consulate stamps) or we can require a US-based notary when they arrive. Which is Rafa's timeline?
rafa-newhire: Hi all 44b I'm arriving in the US two weeks after start date, so consular stamp would be easiest now. I have passport + visa + I-94 copy.
sara-hr: Consular stamp path works. We'll need a certified copy or an apostille? For some countries consulate stamp + original passport page is fine. I'll check compliance.
checkr-bot: Checkr update: preliminary report received 0a. Note: alias detected: report shows previous employment under "Rafael S.". Please confirm any known aliases.
rafa-newhire: Yes, I used "Rafael S." at my prior role (short form). That's the same person. Happy to upload documents to confirm.
lee-ops: For payroll/benefits we need SSN or ITIN. If Rafa doesn't have SSN yet, payroll can create a placeholder but taxes may require later update. Also need a US mailing address for welcome kit. Rafa, do you have a friend/family address we can ship to temporarily?
rafa-newhire: I can use a relative's address: 22 Willow Ave, Unit B.
toni-it: Heads up on access: corporate laptop shipping to US addresses only. If hardware arrives after Rafa lands, we'll provide cloud-hosted dev box for day 1. MFA requires a mobile phone for authenticator app.
sara-hr: Action from HR compliance: I'll draft a short attestation email for consular I-9 acceptance and request a high-res scan of the passport visa page. Also will confirm whether an apostille is needed.
lee-ops: Benefits timing: open enrollment window is 30 days from first paycheck. If they're not on payroll by first payroll run, they can still enroll within window but admin will need to manually sync. Flagging payroll to monitor.
checkr-bot: Background check: pending identity verification step due to alias. Checkr requesting docs.
rafa-newhire: Uploaded passport page and e-sign consent to Checkr and to the secure HR portal. Let me know if anything else.
toni-it: Ticket IT-9082 created for Rafa. Provisioning note: cloud-hosted dev VM will be ready by 09:00 PT on day 1. We'll ship laptop once Rafa has a US address confirmed in payroll.
hr-bot: Reminder: Orientation invite sent to rafa-newhire for Day 1 | 09:30-12:00 PT (hybrid): intro, benefits, security, manager meet.
sara-hr: Thanks all. Quick checklist summary:
- sara-hr: confirm consular acceptance + send attestation template (due today)
- rafa-newhire: confirm alias explanation in a short note + provide passport scans (done)
- lee-ops: notify payroll to setup placeholder payroll record & use relative address (due today)
- toni-it: prepare cloud VM for day 1, create IT-9082 (done)
If Checkr doesn't clear in 5 business days, escalate to me. Post updates here. :thumbsup:
rafa-newhire: Got it, thanks! Appreciate the flexibility on consular route and the cloud VM for day 1.
sara-hr: Closing loop for now. I'll post compliance confirmation in this thread once I hear back from legal.
